stem: A dirty receiving rack is discovered. What is the correct principle?
choices: Use it because the lot will dry
Correct or isolate the sanitation problem through procedure before harvested material contacts the rack
rationale: Correct or isolate the sanitation problem through procedure before harvested material contacts the rack. This preserves the Course 006 safety, postharvest, traceability, contamination-control, authority or record-quality principle being assessed.
